{
  "states": [
    "not authenticated state",

      "event": "LOGIN",

      "to": "authenticated state"
    },
    {
      "from": "authenticated state",
      "event": "SELECT",
      "action": "OK - select completed",
      "to": "selected state"
    },
    {
      "from": "authenticated state",
      "event": "EXAMINE",
      "action": "OK - examine completed",
      "to": "selected state"
    },
    {
      "from": "selected state",
      "event": "CLOSE",
      "action": "OK - close completed",
      "to": "authenticated state"
    },
    {
      "from": "selected state",
      "event": "UNSELECT",
      "action": "OK - unselect completed",
      "to": "authenticated state"
    },
    {
      "from": "selected state",
      "event": "SELECT",
      "action": "OK - select completed",
      "to": "selected state"
    },
    {
      "from": "selected state",
      "event": "EXAMINE",
      "action": "OK - examine completed",
      "to": "selected state"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

{
  "states": [
    "selected state",
    "authenticated state"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "selected state",

    }
  ]
}
